title: ceph-csi: pprof-exposed-go @ internal/util/httpserver.go:37
install: pinned module github.com/ceph/ceph-csi v3.18.1 via go proxy (go.sum recorded in evidence); Go probe built with go1.27

root_cause.note: internal/util/httpserver.go imports net/http/pprof non-blank (line 6), so its init() registers /debug/pprof/* on the DEFAULT net/http mux; StartMetricsServer (line 29) serves that same default mux on MetricsIP:MetricsPort with no authentication and cmd/cephcsi.go:255 defaults MetricsIP to 0.0.0.0. Verified dynamically: /debug/pprof/cmdline, /debug/pprof/heap and /metrics all return 200 without credentials. Additional upstream defect observed while reproducing: the verbatim EnableProfiling/addPath registers profile names without a leading slash, which panics on Go >= 1.22 ServeMux pattern rules.

preconditions: cephcsi pod network-reachable on the metrics port (default bind 0.0.0.0)
profiling enabled via --enableprofiling (registration itself is unconditional in EnableProfiling)
steps: extract the verbatim pinned ValidateURL/StartMetricsServer/addPath/EnableProfiling and the Config struct
import the real internal/util/log package from the pinned module
call the real EnableProfiling() and StartMetricsServer() and fetch /debug/pprof/* + /metrics with no credentials
expected_evidence: run.json with the verbatim extraction hashes and module go.sum
cleanup: probe HTTP server runs in-process and exits with the probe
notes: Unauthenticated pprof + prometheus metrics ride the same default-mux listener the CSI binary serves; default bind is 0.0.0.0. Dynamic function-level reproduction with the verbatim pinned registration and server functions; impact = cpu/heap profiling (secret extraction surface) reachable without credentials.
